notes.title: The very first Sally demo is out!
notes.content:
We’re so happy to share a little bit of what’s to come with this playable little teaser. You can expect:

 A unique crew that changes every playthrough!
 Emergent interactions
 Environments to explore aboard the ship - and more
 5 workstations to try out
 Different routes depending on your choices
 And of course, two grandmas to guide you through it all

Please note that this demo is a limited preview of what’s to come and is not meant to reflect the quality of the final product. It is an incomplete build meant to share a small part of Sally, whilst testing out some features in their early stages. This work in progress can only hint at the many final features, mechanics, accessibility options and content that are still to be polished and/or added to the final product. Sally will come to early access in Q4 next year. 

New Patch Release!

Thanks to everyone who already took the time to fill in a bug report. Our team has been hard at work fixing the demo to make a more enjoyable product for everyone, and a new version is now available!

In this patch, we: 

 Made the foundry station more intuitive and added clearer instructions
 Fixed the cast selector bug in the foundry
 Enhanced AI navigation
 Fixed bugs that stopped progression
 Fixed bugs concerning UI and controls display
 Shortened loading times
 Added a loading screen
 Adjusted sound balance (lowered the machine room, for example)
 Fixed how the crewmates interact with the cauldron station
 Fixed your crewmates running away with the game’s camera
 Slowed down the progression of days
 Fixed an array of other small bugs and frictions.

Please note that some frictions in gameplay are due to incomplete features in the demo. For example, the final inventory will be larger, with stackable slots.

Apologies in advance for all and any bugs still present. Should you encounter some, you are welcome to fill in the bug-report form, so our team can address them. We are also open to all accessibility requests. Whilst realistically, we couldn’t add these features to the demo, we would love to make sure they’re present in the early access version of the game, in Q4 2025.

Bugs will be addressed for the duration of the Steam Next Fest - please don’t forget to update your demo to the latest version available!

Thank you, and enjoy your time aboard the Sally!

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Hello travelers!

With the Sally Demo now available, we wanted to share information on the game's Steam Deck compatibility.

Currently, we have optimized the game to run at a relatively stable 30-40 frames per second on the Steam Deck. It is configured at a slightly lower graphics quality than when running on Windows to ensure a smooth experience. It uses a Linux-native build, ensuring optimal compatibility.

If the Demo doesn't launch for you, you can try forcing it to use Proton. We have tested version 9.0-4 and Experimental. Note that it might take longer at first launch due to installing Unreal Engine prerequisites.

We are aware that the island can sometimes drop to frame rates lower than 30 and are working on optimizing the area.

[hr][/hr]
If you encounter any issues when running the Demo on the Steam Deck, please make sure to file a bug report, as it will help us provide a better experience.

This post has been updated as of the May 2025 re-release of the demo.
